summary: Derives the core preview (head, eye plate, eyes, maps) per body from the player's game files, one derivation at a time.

faults.when: The core couldn't be derived from the game files; a plain code and message.

lifetime: Per body and installation, while a scene of that body is shown or Settings asks to prepare.

x-friction.gap: One preparation at a time across bodies is a hand-written limit per kind of work.
x-friction.closes: Limits per kind of work as data.
